description: Florida business entities from the Division of Corporations (Sunbiz): name search (document number, status, detail URL; 20 per page) or one record via a result URL: entity type, document number, FEI/EIN, filing date, status, last event, principal and mailing address, registered agent, officers with addresses, annual report years and document links. Via a residential proxy. Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

detail.description: The url of a search result (https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/SearchResultDetail?...) to fetch that full record

name.description: Entity name to search (alphabetical list starting at this name), e.g. apple
